answers.core: This should be core because as an editor in the front end it feels inconsistent to have windows close, and it's a fairly integral part being in the dock window area. For most of my needs there should only be one Sprite Frames window, and I need to cross-reference it very often with other items, such as other nodes or the Animation Player. Aside from the floating I demonstrated in the video, it's been an issue for multiple 4.x versions.
answers.workaround: Maybe a tool button that auto-selects the highest AnimatedSprite node?

title: Allow SpriteFrames dock window to pin and not close when selecting other nodes
